proposals.before: The Bohai people of Raozhou rose at a subordinate city under Goutou, fielding more than thirty thousand infantry and cavalry; no summons could make them submit.
proposals.after: The Bohai people of Raozhou organized touxia subordinate cities in rebellion, fielding more than thirty thousand infantry and cavalry; no summons could make them submit.
proposals.reason: 結構頭下城 means organizing/joining touxia (頭下) cities, not a personal name Goutou; the idiomatic reading invents a person absent from the Chinese.

proposals.before: He later retired as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and died in office.
proposals.after: He later retired as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and died.
proposals.reason: Chinese 以致仕，卒 records retirement then death, not death while still in office; "died in office" contradicts 致仕.

proposals.before: For his merit he was made chancellor of the Northern Prefecture, with the additional title of left vice director and concurrent commander of the Eastern Route army.
proposals.after: For his merit he was made chancellor of the Northern Prefecture, with the additional title of left vice director and concurrent commander of the Northeast Route army.
proposals.reason: 東北路 is the Northeast Route, not Eastern Route; the idiomatic omits 北.

decisions.after: The Bohai people of Raozhou joined forces with a touxia appanage city in rebellion, fielding more than thirty thousand infantry and cavalry; summonses failed to bring them to submit.
decisions.reason: 頭下城 is a Liao touxia appanage city, not a person named Goutou, and 結構 means to conspire or join forces. The revision restores the institution and natural syntax without turning the city type into a plural organizer.
後以太子太傅致仕，卒 records retirement from office (致仕) followed by death (卒); "died in office" contradicts 致仕. The proposed English correctly separates retirement and death.
兼東北路都統 names the Northeast Route (東北路), not an Eastern Route; the idiomatic English dropped 北. The proposed replacement restores the full route name.
